mapper.select:
select t.ggName, t.fbDate, t.csName, t.teamMeetingId, t.deptId, t.schoolName, t.firstzj, t.secondzj from (select ar.notice_title ggName, ar.create_time fbDate, ar.transaction_company_name csName, ar.team_id teamMeetingId, ar.dept_id deptId, dept.dept_name schoolName, ar.ancestors, case when exists (select 1 from xfpt_supplice_inspection_report_son s left join xfpt_supplice_inspection_report sp on s.report_id = sp.id where sp.dept_id = ar.dept_id and sp.del_flag = 0 and s.del_flag = 0 and sp.team_meeting_id = ar.team_id and s.type = 1) then '1' else '0' end as firstzj, case when exists (select 1 from xfpt_supplice_inspection_report_son s left join xfpt_supplice_inspection_report sp on s.report_id = sp.id where sp.dept_id = ar.dept_id and sp.del_flag = 0 and s.del_flag = 0 and sp.team_meeting_id = ar.team_id and s.type = 2) then '1' else '0' end as secondzj from xfpt_anno_results ar left join sys_dept dept on ar.dept_id = dept.dept_id
ar.del_flag = 0
AND date_format(ar.create_time,'%Y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%Y%m%d')
AND date_format(ar.create_time,'%Y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%Y%m%d')
and ar.team_id in
#{teamIdCurr}
order by ar.create_time desc ) t
t.schoolName like concat('%',#{schoolName},'%')
and t.csName like concat('%',#{csName},'%')
and t.firstzj = #{firstzj}
and t.secondzj = #{secondzj}

select t.schoolName, t.ggCount, t.hasZjCount, t.noZjCount, t.hasSecondZjCount from (select ar.dept_id deptId, dept.dept_name schoolName, count(ar.dept_id) ggCount, (select count(1) from xfpt_supplice_inspection_report_son s left join xfpt_supplice_inspection_report sp on s.report_id = sp.id where sp.dept_id = ar.dept_id and sp.del_flag = 0 and s.del_flag = 0
and sp.id in
#{inspectIdCurr}
and s.type = 1) as hasZjCount, (count(ar.dept_id) - (select count(1) from xfpt_supplice_inspection_report_son s left join xfpt_supplice_inspection_report sp on s.report_id = sp.id where sp.dept_id = ar.dept_id and sp.del_flag = 0 and s.del_flag = 0
and sp.id in
#{inspectIdCurr}
and s.type = 1)) as noZjCount, (select count(1) from xfpt_supplice_inspection_report_son s left join xfpt_supplice_inspection_report sp on s.report_id = sp.id where sp.dept_id = ar.dept_id and sp.del_flag = 0 and s.del_flag = 0
and sp.id in
#{inspectIdCurr}
and s.type = 2) as hasSecondZjCount from xfpt_anno_results ar left join sys_dept dept on ar.dept_id = dept.dept_id where ar.del_flag = 0
and ar.team_id in
#{teamIdCurr}
group by ar.dept_id,dept.dept_name) t
t.schoolName like concat('%',#{schoolName},'%')
and (t.hasZjCount >= t.ggCount * #{conditionFirstOne} and t.hasZjCount <= t.ggCount * #{conditionFirstTwo} )
and (t.hasSecondZjCount >= t.ggCount * #{conditionSecondOne} and t.hasSecondZjCount <= t.ggCount * #{conditionSecondTwo} )
